title: ZeroLagg
description: This modpack adds a way for low end systems to enjoy playing minecraft
body: This is a simple modpack, designed to be lightweight and heavily boost performance on almost any system. We've removed any bloatware, and most QOL mods, if you'd like a modpack with shaders, resourcepacks, and qol mods installed, check out our other modpack ZeroQOL, coming soon to Modrinth.
